observations.why: Directive verb targets a desired change in knowledge state — future-oriented, irrealis (commanded, not actual), abstract (knowledge category, not a specific event).

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Directive verb commands a future action targeting concrete named artifacts (Kestrelwood spectrograph, 88.4 MHz calibration, Quill Ashgrove) — irrealis because it is desired, not yet actual.
Assertive claim about a past non-event — realis (settled fact about what did not happen), past focus, concrete (specific observatory and instrument).
